description: This file defines the DataTableManager class for managing bank reconciliation data tables in the ERPNext application, including data fetching, formatting, rendering, and event handling.

classes.name: DataTableManager
classes.description: Manages the data table for bank reconciliation, including data retrieval, formatting, display, and user interactions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DataTableManager with options, sets up dialog manager, and creates the data table.

methods.name: make_dt
methods.description: Fetches bank transactions and initializes the data table.

methods.name: get_dt_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the data table.

methods.name: format_data
methods.description: Formats raw transaction data into table rows.

methods.name: format_row
methods.description: Converts a transaction object into a table row array.

methods.name: get_datatable
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataTable instance.

methods.name: set_listeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for user interactions on the data table.

methods.name: update_dt_cards
methods.description: Updates the UI cards based on a bank transaction.

methods.name: get_cleared_balance
methods.description: Retrieves the cleared bank balance up to a specified date.
